name: Decision Watch Lifecycle
acceptance_criteria: creates active watches with validated company and decision-subject scope at revision zero
updates conditions and timing fields without allowing identity or scope changes
pauses, resumes, and soft-closes watches through an explicit state transition policy
treats closed watches as terminal and rejects resume of expired watches
clears stale evaluation timing when condition or interval changes
emits minimized lifecycle events without expected values or source payloads
uses expected revisions and stable command IDs for host atomic compare-and-swap and idempotency
does not provide storage, listing, authorization, scheduling, notifications, or action execution
all plans and events carry authority_effect none

verification.note: Tests are deferred until the broader archive integration pass ends.

host_owned_components: watch listing and company-scoped durable storage
authorization, command receipt retention, and atomic revision compare-and-swap
lifecycle event persistence and scheduler updates
